instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.

arguments.note: The charger lies on the left with its prongs toward the front. I will first approach its body from above, leaving the prongs clear.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 42 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The first rotation stopped partway. I will finish the downward orientation while moving over the charger.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 27 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The wrist view places the charger farther forward and slightly left of the hand. I will approach above that body position.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The longer approach was refused. I will use a closer intermediate pose above the charger.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger body is slightly left of centre and angled. I will lower above it and align the jaws with its sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is beneath the open jaws. I will correct their rotation and approach just above the body before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The body is slightly left and toward the front in the wrist view. I will make a short alignment and lowering correction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is centred between the jaws. I will lower five millimetres and close on its body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws closed fully rather than holding the charger, so the grasp missed. I will reopen and raise slightly before shifting toward the body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The missed grasp was behind the charger. I will bring the jaw centre forward onto its body while keeping the jaws open.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The body is now aligned across the closing path. I will lower in a small increment to engage its sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are aligned around the upper body, clear of the prongs. I will lower another five millimetres and grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws stopped on the charger body. I will lift it clear of the table before turning its prongs downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger lifted securely. I will carry it toward the central workspace, where both arms can reach.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip is far from the left arm. I will prepare the right hand to move the strip closer before insertion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip runs diagonally across the table. I will turn the jaws across its narrow dimension and approach from above.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip is visible between the jaws. I will lower above it and refine the cross-strip angle.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip is slightly off the jaw centre. I will align across its sides and approach the gripping height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip is centred between the jaws. I will close around its side walls.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The right jaws have gripped the strip. I will lift it clear before moving it centrally.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will place the strip in the shared workspace and straighten its socket row for easier prong alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 29 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The strip is nearly horizontal and partly across. I will finish centring it and lower close to the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip is above its resting height. I will lower it toward the tabletop while retaining the grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will settle the strip the final few millimetres and release it on the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip is resting centrally. I will raise the idle hand to clear the insertion path and obtain an overhead view.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined retreat was unreachable. I will first raise the right hand without rotating it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is clear of the table. I will start tipping its exposed prongs downward and align their spacing with the socket row.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will finish the quarter-turn so the charger stands upright with its prongs pointing down.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The charger is nearly upright. I will bring its prongs above the left socket, keeping clearance for visual alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The overhead view shows the charger slightly in front of the socket row. I will shift it back and approach the socket carefully.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is close to the socket row. I will refine its lateral alignment and lower four millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The prongs now appear centred over the socket. I will lower four millimetres and check for contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The last descent nearly reached its target. I will make another small insertion step, watching for resistance or displacement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger shifted upward in the jaws, suggesting the prongs met the socket face rather than entering. I will lift slightly to realign without pressing harder.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The exposed socket slots appear slightly right and behind the prongs. I will make a few-millimetre alignment correction while lifted.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will make a two-millimetre centring correction and resume the gentle descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The socket slots are centred beneath the charger. I will lower another four millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger descended without shifting in the jaws. I will continue insertion by four millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The prongs are disappearing into the socket and the charger remains upright. I will make a final short seating motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: A small gap remains beneath the charger body. I will lower another four millimetres to seat it fully.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger body appears seated against the strip. I will release it gently before withdrawing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The charger remains upright after release. I will withdraw the open left hand away from it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is standing securely in the strip. I will return the left arm to its starting pose.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The direct home motion was refused. I will return through a nearer intermediate pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The left arm is back within its home region. I will return the right arm through an intermediate pose, clear of the plugged-in charger.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 28 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The right arm has cleared the workspace. I will finish returning it to the starting pose.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The exact home target was refused. I will use a nearby pose with a smaller orientation change.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 24 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The right hand is near home but still rotated slightly too far. I will finish its orientation correction, leaving the charger undisturbed.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
